parent_evidence.interpretable_fact: S0 lacked a measurable two-sided target cut; after the 9 already-audited reentry edges S1 had two live disconnected components, LHS size 4 and RHS size 19, with measured cross-distance 10. No scientific claim is made from the post-hoc coverage association in that failed gate.

reframe: Once reentry creates both live target regions, rank replay-valid source-law consequences by predicted contraction of the actual component cut rather than by local target-subterm coverage.
frozen_state: target narrowing plus the same 9 reentry edges only

candidate_family.form: direct instances of the original source law, whose source-x substitution is already a member of either live target component
candidate_family.anchor_terms: all live target-component terms of tree size <= 9
candidate_family.fill_terms: target variables plus distinct live-component terms and target proper subterms of tree size <= 5, sorted by the historical term key and truncated to 16
candidate_family.enumeration: all ordered (anchor_x, y_fill, z_fill) triples, both target components, deduplicated by instantiated equality
candidate_family.admission: both instantiated sides tree size <= 19 and equality edge not already present in either orientation

arms.A_TARGET_COVERAGE: install up to 24 candidates ranked by number of alpha-normalized target-basis subterms in the non-anchor endpoint; deterministic historical-term-key tie break
arms.B_CUT_CONTRACTION: install the same number of candidates ranked first by predicted distance of the non-anchor endpoint to the opposite live component, then historical-term-key tie break

measurements: number of candidates predicted to contract below frozen cross-distance 10
overlap between A and B selected candidate sets

decision_table.NO_ONE_STEP_CUT_CONTRACTOR: the frozen common candidate pool contains zero candidates with predicted opposite-component distance below 10
decision_table.CUT_CONTRACTOR_CAUSAL: B strictly reduces cross-distance or joins/closes while A does not achieve an equal-or-better result
decision_table.TARGET_RANKING_EQUIVALENT: A achieves cross-distance, join, and closure performance equal to or better than B
decision_table.CONTRACTOR_PREDICTION_FAILS: positive predicted contractors exist but B does not reduce the measured post-install cut
decision_table.MEASUREMENT_FAILURE: the S1 parent state, component sizes, 9 reentry edges, cap 19, or matched arm count cannot be reconstructed

attack_rule: If CUT_CONTRACTOR_CAUSAL, ablate cut ranking while preserving candidate pool before any transfer. If NO_ONE_STEP_CUT_CONTRACTOR, do not enlarge the pool immediately; factor why the source law cannot produce a one-step contractor from the live cut.
